title: Research reads, searches, licences and anchors sources by tool
goal: provider.py read fetches a url in its provider's raw form and prints the lines that hold the grep words; provider.py search queries a provider's own search API before WebSearch; kbid.py add reads a new source's licence and reuse from the source's own licence record; and factdiff.py anchor takes the researcher's verbatim quote, with kb-verify warning of a new DOC fact whose quote the page does not hold
